market_header.rules:
MARKET INFORMATION

For further information please see Rules & Regs.

Who will win this race? Betfair Non-Runner Rule applies. Reduction factors may be updated periodically at the discretion of Betfair based on trading in the market, but after approximately 5 minutes from scheduled ‘off’ time of a given race, they will be updated only in exceptional circumstances. Odds of matched bets will only be adjusted if there are ADDITIONAL non-runners after your bet is matched. This market will turn IN PLAY at the off with all unmatched bets cancelled once the Betfair SP reconciliation process has been completed. Betting will be suspended at the end of the race. This market will initially be settled on a First Past the Post basis. However we will re-settle all bets should the official result at the time of the "weigh-in" announcement differ from any initial settlement. Dead Heat rules apply.

BSP (Betfair Starting Price) operates on this market. For more information about setting a Starting Price odds limit click here

This is a cross-matching market.

Customers should be aware that:
  1. Transmissions described as "live" by some broadcasters may actually be delayed and that all in-play races are not necessarily televised;
  2. The extent of any such delay may vary between customers, depending on the set-up through which they are receiving pictures or data.
  3. Information (such as jockey silks, saddlecloth numbers etc) is provided "as is" and is for guidance only. Betfair does not guarantee the accuracy of this information and use of it to place bets is entirely at your own risk.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns after two months following a plain first-up run at Warrnambool, where he began slowly, finished last and was beaten just under eight lengths after being near the top of an open market. His Wangaratta fourth before that was more encouraging, making ground when beaten two and a half lengths. Has placed at 1000m, but recent form and top weight make this a tough task.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Makes his debut with a tidy lead-up, having won a Flemington trial after an earlier fourth in the same trial series. The Ben, Will & JD Hayes yard has a solid first-starter record, and the trainer-sire combination also has useful strike-rate figures. Drawn nicely and can play a leading role.

runnerMetadata.coloursDescription: Bottle Green White Checked Sleeves White Cap

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns after five months since a debut Mdn at Sale where he led as a well-supported favourite but weakened to finish last, beaten just over six lengths on heavy ground. That was a disappointing race-day start, though his trial file is stronger, with multiple wins before a latest unplaced Pakenham trial. Didn't handle the heavy going on debut but can make amends here.

He was third in a Mdn at Ballarat Synthetic before the break after racing wide, following a long-neck second at Cranbourne on heavy ground. Looks set for a strong showing first-up.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns after eight months following a debut at Werribee where she jumped awkwardly, settled well back and finished ninth, beaten nine and a half lengths at long odds. Four trials this time in, including a latest third at Sandown-Hillside, should have advanced her fitness. Four trials help, but she has plenty to find from a wide draw.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Starts her racing career after two recent trial seconds, the latest a close effort at Mortlake, so there is at least some readiness in the profile. Her dam has produced several winners, headed by Extra Mile, but there is no race form to measure her against this field. Race-day proof is the missing piece.
rnsMetadata.jockeyColours: Purple, Gold Star, Black Crossed Sashes And Sleeves, Gold Stars, Black Stripe Cap, Gold Stars

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Comes to the races as a NZ$80,000 purchase for the Clinton McDonald stable, which has a respectable first-starter record. Her recent Cranbourne trials have been educational rather than eye-catching, but the trainer-sire combination has returned strong figures from limited runners. Trials only fair, but the profile earns place respect.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Draws barrier 1 for her debut and gets Jamie Melham, which are useful advantages for a first starter. Her trial sequence has been quiet overall, though she has had five hit-outs and comes from a half-sibling line that includes Wangi Wangi, a debut winner over 1100m. Looks to have found a suitable race on debut.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Finished fourth in a Mdn at Yarra Valley first-up, beaten a length and a half, and the run had merit after he was held up passing the 200m before chasing soundly. He was safely held on debut at Bendigo when well found in the market, so improvement still has to be confirmed. Has the race fitness and a strong showing is on the cards.
